description: NaDyO₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/amd space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent DyO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent DyO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are four shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.85 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Dy³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form DyO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent DyO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent DyO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and four longer (2.31 Å) Dy-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Dy³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Dy₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Dy³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Dy₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There is one shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.31 Å) O-Dy bond lengths.
